name: human-review
description: Review and edit agent-generated files and localhost pages in the browser, then send the whole batch back to your agent.

interface.longDescription: Human Review lets you open HTML, Markdown, localhost pages, plans, and structured review artifacts in a browser. Edit content directly, leave comments, mark sections for revision, and send the complete feedback batch back to your agent. The workflow runs locally and preserves the existing Human Review CLI and offline planning and LOA artifact behavior.
capabilities: Visually review HTML, Markdown, and localhost pages
Edit content directly and send comments to your agent
Review plans and structured Lists of Actions offline
defaultPrompt: Open this file for visual review and collect my edits and comments.
Create a review artifact for this plan and let me mark sections.
Review this localhost page and send one feedback batch to my agent.
